description: This file defines the ActivityFragment class, a simple Fragment subclass used to display an 'Activity' heading in a smart home TV application. It inflates a layout resource and provides a factory method for instantiation.

classes.name: ActivityFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that displays a placeholder view with an 'Activity' heading, used within the TV app to navigate to the activity section.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overrides Fragment's onCreateView to inflate the fragment layout.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of ActivityFragment.
